sections.text:
Inspection Before Isolated the Pump 
 Mechanically and Electrically
Check any vibration of the pump
Check any noise of the pump

Check the amount of leakage from stuffing box 
 and minimized it by retighten the mechanical seal bolts

Check any leakage from the pipe's connections to 
 the pump

Check leakage of lubricating grease in bearing 
 house of the pump
Check the pressure in the pump's delivery

Check the temperature of all bearing house, it 
 must be less than 70C

Inspection After Isolated the Pump 
 Mechanically and Electrically

Check the screw spindle and casing from mechanical wear and 
 measure the clearances by dismantle the pump

Change the mechanical seal if leakage is heavy and didn't 
 prevented by tighten

Prevent the leakage of lubricating grease from bearing house 
 of the pump
Change the lubricating grease in pump
Check the coupling's bolts and change if needed
Retighten all bolts connected pump and motor with foundation
تحقق من المحاذاة بين المضخة والمحرك
